Recently I've started doing the elliptical, but even after 5k I barely break a sweat on that thing, even with an elevated heart rate. I considered swimming laps, but that would require bending my foot in a way that may aggravate the condition. I'm currently thinking about just doing some lifting instead, I'm allowed (according to da bone doc) to support weight on it, just not allowed to be flexible with it (ie., walking on gravel etc.,).

I'm currently looking into doing either Jason Blaha's Ice Cream Fitness or StrongLifts 5x5 to bulk up some muscle and burn a bit of this softness off because they seem simple and wouldn't require more than 1-2hrs in the gym.
